steps.text: Click "Export the community's data". The archive gathers its members, meters and their consumption, sharing operations, allocation keys, documents, invoices and the aggregates of its smart meters. It contains neither anyone's notifications nor a member's individual curve. As for a personal export, a recent sign-in is required.
steps.title: Ask for the export

steps.text: The file will contain the personal data of every member: you are responsible for it. Keep it somewhere safe, share it only with the people who need it, and delete it once you no longer need it. The other administrators are told of your request and see it in the list, but only you can download the file. Click "Export" to confirm.
steps.title: Read the warning

steps.text: The list shows every export of the community: who asked for it, when, and its state. This one goes from "In preparation" to "Ready" by itself; a notification and an email also tell you. The file stays available for seven days.
steps.title: Wait for "Ready"

steps.text: The list shows every export of the community: who asked for it, when, and its state. This one goes from "In preparation" to "Ready" by itself; a notification and an email also tell you. The file stays available for seven days.
steps.title: Wait for "Ready"

steps.text: Click "Download": the ZIP file is saved to your computer. It holds one folder per service, JSON and CSV files, and a manifest.json that describes each of them. Another administrator sees this export in the list, without a "Download" button.
steps.title: Download the archive
